jobs.title: Forward Deployed Creative (US)
jobs.summary: Be Luma's creative lead with major brands and agencies: build AI production workflows with them and make high-craft work in Dream Machine yourself as the proof. Senior role, the first of its kind in the region.

jobs.title: AI Video Creator (freelance)
jobs.summary: Make marketing videos with AI video tools that show off HLHC's platform and grow the brand on social media. They ask for storytelling skills and a portfolio of past AI video work. HLHC is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.

jobs.title: AI Content Producer (DTC ads)
jobs.summary: Generate ad-ready, realistic AI video scenes for DTC gift brands, about 40+ scenes a week, using Sora, Kling, Runway, Veo, Luma or Seedance. Careful visual QA (artifacts, faces, motion) and clean prompt documentation are part of the job.

jobs.title: AI Filmmaker
jobs.summary: Turn brand ideas into cinematic AI films and ads: concepts, scripts, storyboards, then generation in tools like Kling, Runway, Veo, Seedance or Higgsfield and finishing in Premiere, After Effects or Resolve. They ask for 2-4 years of experience; Greyfyre is a digital marketing agency in New Delhi.

jobs.title: Video Creative Lead (DTC ads)
jobs.summary: Lead the video team for a health and beauty DTC brand: sign off every ad, guide editors, and make high-impact ads yourself. They want 5+ years in DTC video plus AI animation and tools like Higgsfield, fal.ai, Suno and Midjourney; shortlisted people do a paid test.

jobs.title: AI Video Creator & Editor (Veo 3 / Kling)
jobs.summary: Turn creative briefs into production-ready AI footage for YouTube ad campaigns for ecommerce brands, using Veo 3, Kling, HeyGen and similar tools. Fully remote, with a steady workload.

jobs.title: Creative
jobs.summary: Join Krea Studio and make launch videos, demos and original projects with Krea, from references and storyboards to finished work. They want a filmmaking, design or animation background and a portfolio of completed projects.

jobs.title: Film / Commercial Director
jobs.summary: Direct commercials, cinematic campaigns and AI-native productions for Higgsfield, from concept to execution. They want strong taste and storytelling, plus AI tool experience or the drive to learn it fast.
